message.content: {"findings": [{"cwe": "CWE-22", "class": "Expand", "method": "expandFile", "explanation": "The tainted archive entry name from ZipEntry.getName() is passed directly to extractFile without any allow-list, path normalization, or containment check."}, {"cwe": "CWE-22", "class": "Expand", "method": "extractFile", "explanation": "extractFile resolves the attacker-controlled entryName with FileUtils.resolveFile(dir, entryName) and then uses the resulting File in new FileOutputStream(f); no check ensures the resolved path is contained within the destination directory, so ../ entries can escape and reach the sink."}]}
